title: The "Ninja Turtles Experience"
content: I found myself in an unfamiliar corridor of a Mall last night, with artwork on the walls advertising a "Ninja Turtles" experience. It was shorter a side corridor leading to a Mall entrance, with the doors to the "Experience" being the only ones in that corridor. I talked to a guy in the corridor (maybe a custodian?) who told me the experience was supposed to be an interactive walkthrough with costumed characters (think: haunted house/escape room type place), but was closed permanently because it was, in his words, "a massive flop." In the nearby main throughway of the mall, I vividly saw a Hallmark Store, a Vision/Eyeglass shop, and a Sears appliance outlet. And in a probably too "on the nose" detail, the Mall Entrance/Exit in that corridor actually had posters with the words "Mall World" by them. Seen anything along those lines before?
